component.name: GhostMEAN
component.summary: Mean Aerodynamic Chord Calculator — open source, no cloud, no account

description.p: GhostMEAN computes the Mean Aerodynamic Chord (M.A.C.), wing area, aspect ratio, and CG balance points for multi-panel model aircraft wings, with a live top-down preview, per-panel Station View, and CSV/PDF export. Everything runs locally — no account, no cloud, no subscription.
